summary: This is a Form 8-K filed by Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Trust 2016-C36, an asset-backed securitization vehicle, reporting under Item 8.01 a routine servicing administration update. The filing discloses that LNR Partners was removed as general special servicer and Argentic Services Company was appointed successor for the Central Park Retail and One Two Corporate Plaza mortgage loans under the WFCMT 2016-LC24 pooling and servicing agreement. This is an administrative servicing change, not a corporate special situation. No deal terms, prices, or strategic events are present. The filing is purely informational regarding servicer succession, with no market-moving implications.
